t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Méni yicuni testigo, oh Yandioxhié, meni xhebañiá ja xhiñiñáani ja cuiniñani. Xhedecu-endañá'ana nicu bidna acu jadañá'ana ja cu tenu, dxicu jandá'bina zhi cuni cá'nu. Atiu ina Yandioxhe maca jamén, te taxhi ayuda nicu peligru, yicuni valimeni.
